answer: An attacker therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 50 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The jade counter is kept in copper and wharf publishes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 50 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 4118 identities would post 2407 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
